description: Write or remove one day's entry in a trip's diary; owner only. `put` creates the day's entry or replaces it whole: `entry.public` defaults to false when omitted, so leave it out only to take an entry off the public share page. A date outside the trip's dates is validation_failed. `delete` removes the day's entry; deleting a day that has none succeeds and changes nothing. Both take an optional `expectedUpdatedAt` (the entry's updatedAt as you read it): if the entry changed or was removed since, nothing is written and the answer is stale_write with the current version (`actual`, or null when the day has no entry). To write a day you saw empty without overwriting an entry someone else wrote meanwhile, `put` with `expectedAbsent: true` instead (never together with `expectedUpdatedAt`, which is bad_request); a day that has an entry by then answers stale_write with its version as `actual`. A trip's diary holds at most one entry per calendar day of the trip, addressed by the trip id and the date (YYYY-MM-DD, the trip's local calendar date, between the trip's startDate and endDate inclusive). An entry's `body` is plain text (1-8000 characters, not only whitespace; line breaks are kept). `public` says whether the entry shows on the trip's public share page; the owner and linked crew see every entry either way. IDs are 6-character case-sensitive alphanumeric strings. Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601. Distances are integer meters. Durations are integer seconds.
name: diary_write
title: Change the diary
